# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security issue in ZeroBook, please report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories for this repository.

If private reporting is not available, contact the repository owner through their GitHub profile instead of opening a public issue.

Please include:

- A short summary of the issue
- The affected screen, module, or workflow
- Reproduction steps, if available
- Any screenshots, logs, or sample data that help explain the problem

We will review reports as quickly as possible and coordinate a fix before public disclosure.
